name: cta-photo-split
title: Photo split CTA
description: A closing ask beside a real photograph: the picture fills one half edge to edge, the copy and action the other.
docs: Pass title, description, points, actions (a button or two), note and image. image is an img, a picture or your framework's image: it fills its half edge to edge and is cropped to fit, in a space that is fixed (16:9 on a phone, the height of the copy on a wide screen), so the card does not move as it loads, and it is never revealed by an animation. imageSide puts it on the left or the right on a wide screen; on a phone it is always above the copy. Give the photograph real alt text. It is a server component and needs no client JavaScript.
